extracted.intended_audience: investor relations professionals, IROs, corporate communications and management teams at public companies
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for building and operating a modern investor relations (IR) function and producing IR communications (press releases, earnings presentations, IR website, roadshows, shareholder monitoring, etc.) to engage investors, analysts, and internal stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Building confidence in the company in the investment community
rubrics_metrics.description: Build confidence in the company in the investment community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a core IR function: reinforce management and company credibility via regular engagement, consistent messaging, and evidence of strategy execution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communicate the company story consistently, comprehensively, and accurately
rubrics_metrics.description: Communicate the company story and differentiators consistently, comprehensively, and accurately with existing and prospective investors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use multiple channels (presentations, annual report, IR website, newsletters) and ensure messages align across communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage and align market expectations via clear, consistent dialogue
rubrics_metrics.description: Manage and align expectations via clear, consistent dialogue with the markets around earnings, net debt levels, shareholder remuneration, corporate strategy, and market conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regular communications (earnings announcements, roadshows) help stabilize perceptions and reduce surprise-driven volatility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain relationships and communications with analysts
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain relationships and communications with analysts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proactively schedule calls after earnings or events, organize analyst days, and provide analysts with appropriate materials (within regulatory limits).

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish, build, and maintain relationships with shareholders
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish, build, and maintain relationships with shareholders to reinforce management and company credibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regular meetings, follow-ups, and tailored materials build trust and can convert meetings into long-term holders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find new, good-fit investors to diversify shareholder base
rubrics_metrics.description: Find new, good-fit investors for the company to diversify the shareholder base.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define an Ideal Investor Profile, target peers’ holders, and avoid 'spray and pray' approaches to maximize conversion rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build internal awareness of the IR function and its benefits
rubrics_metrics.description: Build internal awareness of the investor relations function and its benefits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Educate management and board on IR objectives, activities, and resource needs to secure buy-in and coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand and keep management aware of market perception and issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Understand and keep management aware of market perception and possible issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track analyst research, investor feedback, and sentiment to inform management and board reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop and maintain the investor relations strategy and program
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop and maintain the investor relations strategy and program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define objectives, goals, strategies, and measurements; update as company stage and market conditions change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IR must operate within securities regulations when communicating (e.g., limits on price-sensitive information) and ensure disclosures meet legal obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop and maintain a corporate disclosure policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop and maintain the investor relations corporate disclosure policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A clear disclosure policy guides timing, channels, and content of material information to satisfy regulators and markets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinctive presence in the investment community
rubrics_metrics.description: Have a distinctive presence in the investment community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Being recognizable and consistently present increases the chance investors understand and value your story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clearly articulated company value story and differentiation
rubrics_metrics.description: Understanding of the company value story and how that differentiates the company from competitors and competing investment opportunities by the market.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Translate strategic advantages into investor-facing messaging that highlights competitive positioning and long-term value creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrate strengths of company management
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrate the strengths of your company management.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use management bios, track record, and behaviour in meetings and presentations to build credibility with investors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build sell-side analyst coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Build sell-side analyst coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target appropriate brokers/analysts (consider firm size, analyst tenure, coverage breadth) to increase visibility and credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grow and expand shareholder base
rubrics_metrics.description: Expansion of shareholder base.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target new investors and analysts whose strategies match the company to improve liquidity and lower cost of capital.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consistent and fair valuations
rubrics_metrics.description: Achieve consistent and fair valuations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reduce volatility and mispricing by aligning expectations through transparent communications and consensus management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Easier and cheaper access to capital
rubrics_metrics.description: Improve access to capital and lower financing costs through effective IR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A trusted investor base and clear story can reduce underwriting fees and improve financing outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Produce strong and consistent IR materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Strong and consistent IR materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain high-quality, up-to-date investor presentations, press releases, annual reports, and web content that tell a coherent story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand your shareholders & anticipate changes
rubrics_metrics.description: The IR team should act as the 'voice of the investors' and have a deep understanding of your investors and their expectations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hold regular meetings, track investor profiles, and monitor peer and sector activity to contextualize company performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Know who your investors are (reported & unreported data)
rubrics_metrics.description: Know who your investors are using public filings and non-reported data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine 13F/filings with NOBO/share register analysis to get a more comprehensive and timely view of holders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand market perception via research and estimates
rubrics_metrics.description: Understand how you are perceived in the market by reviewing research and analyst estimates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain records of analyst estimates and meeting notes to track perception and inform messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be an active communicator and maintain an accessible IR website
rubrics_metrics.description: Have easy-to-access IR information available on your IR website and use communication tools to tell your company story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use regulatory filings, quarterly earnings, roadshows, conferences, annual reports, newsletters and social media; ensure website is a first point of contact and contains core materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create a scorecard of performance indicators (mix of financial & non-financial)
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a scorecard of performance indicators that are a blend of financial and non-financial metrics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid relying on a single KPI (like share price). Use a combination of metrics to measure IR impact over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track meeting history and investment activity
rubrics_metrics.description: Track meeting history and investment activity to understand the impact of your IR strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record meeting notes, outcomes, follow-up tasks and monitor investor activity before and after engagements to measure effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor market data continuously
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitor market data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track trading, analyst activity, ownership changes, and sentiment to spot trends and inform outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secure management buy-in for IR
rubrics_metrics.description: It’s imperative that your management team is committed to investor relations and understands its contribution and the support required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obtain executive sponsorship, allocate budget, and define management involvement in roadshows and meetings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Define objectives, goals, strategy, and measurement
rubrics_metrics.description: Set investor relations objectives, goals, measurement, and strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Objectives = broad direction; Goals = 6–12 month targets; Strategy = how to achieve goals; Measurement = how success is judged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid using share price as sole KPI; use a balanced scorecard
rubrics_metrics.description: Share price performance is a false indicator on its own; use a mixture of soft and hard targets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine financial metrics with perception and activity metrics so management does not look at one metric in isolation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial metrics to measure IR effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Financial metrics include: share price relative to peer group and sector; valuation ratios relative to peers/sector; variance of earnings forecasts; share price volatility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use peer benchmarking to account for market-wide effects when assessing IR outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-financial metrics to measure IR effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Non-financial metrics include: analyst and investor perception survey results; number of investor meetings; effectiveness of meetings (meetings that turned into investors); investor turnover; levels and quality of sell-side coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantify outreach and link activity to conversions and changes in coverage or perception.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create communication pathways to optimize valuation
rubrics_metrics.description: Create communication pathways between the company, the investment community, and other constituents to effectively communicate financial information, strategic plans, and competitive positioning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure two-way channels (meetings, surveys, analyst interactions) so feedback informs strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand and monitor shareholder shifts
rubrics_metrics.description: Understand and monitor shareholder shifts to identify who’s buying/selling and why changes are happening.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use shareholder monitoring to prioritize outreach and to identify potential activists or shifts in retail/institutional composition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target new investors and analysts consistently
rubrics_metrics.description: Consistently reach out to new investors and analysts whose strategies and profiles fit the company to diversify the shareholder base.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regularly update the Ideal Investor Profile and compare against peers to find gaps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build, maintain, upgrade, and distribute IR collateral
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare professional IR materials: presentations, newsletters, annual report, emails, and your IR website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understand your business identity, key messages, supporting data, and distribute through effective channels; tailor materials to audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor market sentiment and analyst forecasts
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitor market sentiment and analyst forecasts to ensure they accurately represent company performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use consensus and estimates to detect misunderstandings; engage analysts to correct inaccuracies where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implement an investor relationship management (CRM) system
rubrics_metrics.description: Use an IR CRM to capture shareholder and engagement data, record activity and provide context to management.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Store meeting notes, investor profiles, and engagement outcomes to prove IR impact and prepare management for events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop a strong company pitch with key elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Your investment proposition/pitch should include: differentiators; company story; positioning vs competitors; management quality; shareholder value metrics (projected returns, cash flows); growth story and strategy; forward-looking industry growth; relevant analyst reports/press; demonstrable catalysts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine these elements to create a credible investment story that stands out vs peers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize key IR communication materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Core IR materials: annual report, IR website, presentations, IR newsletters, press.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize relative roles: annual report = most credible and durable; IR website = widest reach and first contact; presentations = interactive feedback opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrate ESG into IR and collaborate with Sustainability
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrate ESG into the value story and collaborate between IR and Sustainability teams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IR frames sustainability through a financial lens while Sustainability provides operational detail; jointly create transparent ESG communications to attract long-term investors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Periodically review messaging with investor/analyst feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: Messaging should be reviewed periodically with feedback from investors and analysts to ensure points remain relevant and up-to-date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Update slides, website content, and FAQs after major feedback cycles or shifts in strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create a shareholder monitoring plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Successful IR teams should have shareholder monitoring plans: define what to monitor, how to use the information, and how it feeds into communication plans and board reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use monitoring to track ROI of targeting, roadshows, and conferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use both reported and unreported shareholder data appropriately
rubrics_metrics.description: Differentiate reported shareholders (e.g., 13F) and unreported shareholders (NOBO/share register analysis); include both for a comprehensive view.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize delays in public filings and use NOBO and registry analysis to capture more timely or detailed holder information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employ stock surveillance to understand institutional movements
rubrics_metrics.description: Use stock surveillance services combining public data, broker reports, settlement data, market contacts and research to get real-time view of shareholders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stock surveillance helps detect large movements and drivers behind institutional trading.

rubrics_metrics.name: Define an Ideal Investor Profile and avoid 'spray and pray' outreach
rubrics_metrics.description: Define a target investor profile to focus targeting and marketing efforts instead of meeting with every investor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare your shareholder base to peers and identify under-represented investor types to prioritize outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop a roadshow strategy: targeting, scheduling, and preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Plan roadshows with targeted investor lists, detailed itineraries, well-prepared executives, and appropriate tailored materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research attendees, tailor materials by investor preferences (detail vs high-level), ensure data accuracy (include NOBO insights) and track outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Differentiate deal roadshows vs non-deal roadshows and time them appropriately
rubrics_metrics.description: Deal roadshows are for capital raises or IPOs; non-deal roadshows are for investor engagement without selling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-deal roadshows often follow earnings; deal roadshows occur around capital events. Block full days and plan in advance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tips for successful roadshows
rubrics_metrics.description: Undertake investor targeting ahead of roadshows, plan detailed itineraries, support executives with tailored IR materials, ensure all data is available, and keep detailed meeting records.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare tailored versions of presentations for different investor types; ensure follow-up and measurement of meeting effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organize effective Analyst/Capital Markets Days
rubrics_metrics.description: Analyst/Capital Markets Days should provide stakeholders a chance to meet management and gain deeper company information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer virtual options, present in-depth financial/operational strategy or focused deep-dives, post slides after the event, and respect limits on price-sensitive disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use earnings and financial results announcements to set narrative
rubrics_metrics.description: Earnings announcements are key moments to reinforce messages and shape market understanding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide ~4 weeks’ notice, collect analyst estimates, review peers' KPI reporting, rehearse management presentations, and prepare distribution channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribute results via multiple channels
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribute results across newswires, internal distribution lists, social media, and your IR website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use channels to maximize reach and ensure consistent messaging across platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press release content requirements for results announcements
rubrics_metrics.description: Press releases should meet regulatory/disclosure requirements and present a narrative showing the company’s success in realizing strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a headline, summary of results (numbers early), financial/operational highlights, management comment, divisional review, summary and outlook, contact details and reference to the presentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Earnings presentation must-haves
rubrics_metrics.description: Earnings presentation should include: introduction (reinforce strategy, financial highlights), market and competitive review, strategy (long- and short-term goals), detailed financials, outlook and prospects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use presentation to reinforce consistent messaging and provide analysts with comparable KPIs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual report objectives and role
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual report objectives: educate/inform shareholders and prospective investors; explain corporate strategy and its implementation; report financial performance; give context linking results to market; elaborate on risks; provide governance clarity; fulfill regulatory requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annual report should complement other IR materials and serve as the most comprehensive source for due diligence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor research and consensus to reduce expectation gaps
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitor analyst research and consensus to identify misunderstandings and help align market expectations with internal forecasts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage with analysts to correct errors and update guidance where necessary to reduce equity risk premium.

rubrics_metrics.name: Board reporting content for IR
rubrics_metrics.description: Board reports should include notable buyers and sellers with context, trading summary and performance vs peers, ownership profile, exits and entrants trends, shareholder concentration and depth, IR activity metrics, and qualitative commentary (investor quotes, trends, plans).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numbers are important but commentary and context are equally essential for board understanding and decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crisis management planning and communication
rubrics_metrics.description: IR teams must communicate openly and regularly during major crises and have a crisis management plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify risks, establish regular pre-crisis communication with shareholders, become an authoritative information source, involve other stakeholders in plan creation, and rehearse responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: IR website best practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Make IR website easy to navigate, keep content up to date and accurate, use multiple content types (infographics, videos), and ensure mobile adaptability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IR website is often the first place analysts go—design it to be the hub of investor information and to support other outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tailor outreach by investor type (institutional, analyst, VC, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Targeting should recognize different investor types (institutional, sell-side analysts, venture capitalists) and tailor approach accordingly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider investment style, holding size, geography, and fund objectives when prioritizing and customizing materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluate advantages and disadvantages of sell-side coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Weigh pros (visibility, credibility, access to buy-side) and cons (heightened scrutiny, accountability, time commitment) of increasing sell-side coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make strategic decisions about coverage growth based on company stage, objectives and capacity to engage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maximize value from sell-side relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: Maximize sell-side value by proactively scheduling follow-ups, organizing analyst days and site visits, and helping analysts understand the business (within regulatory constraints).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regular engagement with outlier analysts and clarification of assumptions can improve consensus accuracy.
